summary: Ukrainian drone and missile attacks on Russian infrastructure continue, targeting Wildberries warehouses and oil facilities. Russian PVO intercepts numerous drones, but attacks persist. Escalating tensions are evident in increased strike frequency and civilian casualties.

sections.executive_summary: Ukrainian forces launched coordinated attacks on Russian industrial and military targets, including Wildberries warehouses and oil facilities. Russian air defenses intercepted many drones but failed to prevent all strikes. Civilian casualties and infrastructure damage highlight the intensity of operations.

sections.threat_assessment: The frequency and scale of Ukrainian drone and missile attacks on Russian infrastructure indicate a sustained offensive strategy. Targeting industrial sites like Wildberries and oil facilities suggests an effort to disrupt Russian logistics and energy supply. The high casualty count in attacks on civilian infrastructure raises concerns about escalation.
sections.regional_response: Russian authorities have reported intercepting numerous drones but continue to suffer infrastructure damage. The attacks on Wildberries and oil facilities may prompt further Russian countermeasures, including increased PVO deployments or retaliatory strikes. Civilian casualties could fuel domestic unrest in Russia.
sections.intelligence_notes: The targeting of Wildberries warehouses and oil facilities may reflect strategic objectives to disrupt Russian supply chains. The use of drones and ballistic missiles suggests a mix of precision and conventional warfare. The protests in Kyiv indicate potential internal pressure on Ukrainian leadership to address military performance.
